preconditions.description: The length of the array arr is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 30 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Each string in the array arr has a length between 1 and 30.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' or all(prefix in arr for prefix in [return_value[:i] for i in range(1, len(return_value) + 1)])
postconditions.description: The returned string is either empty or all of its prefixes are present in the array.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) <= len(return_value) for s in arr if all(prefix in arr for prefix in [s[:i] for i in range(1, len(s) + 1)]))
postconditions.description: The returned string is the longest string among those that satisfy the prefix condition.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' or (len([s for s in arr if all(prefix in arr for prefix in [s[:i] for i in range(1, len(s) + 1)])]) > 1 and return_value == min([s for s in arr if all(prefix in arr for prefix in [s[:i] for i in range(1, len(s) + 1)])]))
postconditions.description: If there are multiple strings of the same maximum length, the returned string is the lexicographically smallest one.
